map.投喂率为何随水温变化？: Why does the feeding rate vary with water temperature?
map.鱼类代谢随水温升高而增强，适温区间内投喂率提高；过高或过低水温应降低甚至停喂。: Fish metabolism increases as the water warms, so the feeding rate rises within the optimum range; at too high or too low a temperature, reduce it or stop feeding.
map.每次投多少合适？: How much is right per meal?
map.以 30 分钟内吃完、不剩料为原则，过量会败坏水质并浪费饲料。: Aim for everything eaten within 30 minutes with no leftover feed; excess spoils the water and wastes feed.

map.投喂率（查表 + 线性插值）：按品种×规格查温度-投喂率表，区间内按 r = (: Feeding rate (table lookup + linear interpolation): look up the temperature–feeding-rate table by species × size, interpolate within a segment as r = (T−T₁) ÷ (T₂−T₁), take the lowest tier ×0.5 below the table minimum and the highest tier ×0.5 above the maximum when T>32; daily feed = total weight × feeding rate% ÷ 100 (kg); feed per meal = daily feed ÷ meals (shrimp 4 meals when T≥25, otherwise 3; fish 4 when T≥28, 3 when ≥20, otherwise 2). Validation: water temperature outside 0–40℃ or total weight <0 raises a toast error and returns. Grading: no fixed tiers; a temperature–feeding-rate reference table is included.
